query: Draft a social post for the DevFees webinar recap — IG/FB/LI copy.
expected_behavior: Produces a master caption plus per-platform Instagram / Facebook / LinkedIn variants in the IG/FB/LI sub-task pattern, each length- and hashtag-appropriate with an image/aspect note
Writes in Facilitron voice with no em dashes and a single primary CTA per post
Uses AskUserQuestion only when the primary CTA or audience is unclear, rather than interrogating by default

Before drafting, resolves an explicit Drive or Confluence destination plus review state, owner, and approver; success returns the exact durable URL and all target, Jira, asset, and website handoff metadata
Uses one unique scratch workspace, removes it on success and failure, and never branches, opens a worktree, writes repository content, commits, or opens a PR
Stays git-free: produces copy and hands off to the social tools for scheduling
